title: I Lift Them Across
translation: ...for them, whose minds are fixed on me, I soon become the one who lifts them out of the ocean of death and rebirth, O Partha.
translation_hi: ...हे पार्थ, जिनका मन मुझमें लगा है, उन्हें मैं शीघ्र ही मृत्यु रूपी संसार सागर से पार कर देता हूँ।

words.meaning: from the ocean of death and rebirth
